move.title: Move to Ziira Core
move.subtitle: Bring what Ziira has read from {{name}} into Ziira Core: products, customers, suppliers, stock and who owes what. Nothing is deleted or changed in your old system.

kindHint.products: Name, product code and selling price. Product categories are not brought over.
kindHint.customers: Name, phone, email and tax number. A customer already in Ziira with the same phone or tax number is not added twice.
kindHint.suppliers: Name, phone, email and tax number. Bank details are never brought over.
kindHint.opening_stock: What you hold at each branch on the go-live date, worked out from the stock movements, at the average cost it came in at.
kindHint.customer_balances: Each open invoice with its date and due date, so ageing is right. Needs customers, Sales and Finance.
kindHint.supplier_balances: Each open supplier bill with its date and due date. Needs suppliers, Purchasing and Finance.

choose.title: What would you like to bring over?
choose.hint: Tick what you want. You will see exactly what would happen before anything is created.
choose.notAllowed: You do not have permission to bring this over.
choose.goLiveHint: Stock and balances are as at this day. Invoices and movements after it are left out.
choose.unitHint: Products from your old system get this unit. Change it later in Products.
choose.taxHint: Products get this tax class. Change it later in Products.
choose.noUnits: No unit is set up yet.
choose.openSetup: Set up units and tax classes
choose.locationsHint: Stock is brought into one location per branch.
choose.noLocation: This branch has no store yet: add one under Stock > Locations.
choose.noBranches: No branch of your old system is mapped to a Ziira branch yet.
choose.unmapped_one: {{count}} branch of your old system is not mapped to a Ziira branch, so its stock is left out.
choose.unmapped_other: {{count}} branches of your old system are not mapped to a Ziira branch, so their stock is left out.

preview.counts: {{found}} found: {{create}} new, {{exists}} already in Ziira, {{skipped}} left out
preview.notYet: Nothing has been created yet. Stock and balances are as at {{date}}.
preview.users_one: {{count}} user of your old system is not brought over: no passwords are copied. Invite your people under Users.
preview.users_other: {{count}} users of your old system are not brought over: no passwords are copied. Invite your people under Users.

run.runningHint: You can leave this page: it carries on in the background.
run.finishedHint: Stock and balances are as at {{date}}.
run.attention: Some records could not be created. Open the report of the batch that shows a problem, fix the cause and run the move again: records already moved are not created twice.
run.allGood: Everything was moved. Each part has a report that checks the totals.
run.pauseHint: Ziira Core now has your data. Pause the connection so Ziira stops reading the old system. Nothing is deleted, and you can resume it any time.
run.isPaused: The connection is paused. Nothing was deleted.
run.undoHint: Only the balances (what customers owe, what you owe suppliers) can be taken back. Products, customers, suppliers and stock cannot be deleted; switch them off or adjust them in their own screens.
run.undoMessage: The opening balances this move created are reversed together, or not at all.

suggest.title: Ready to run on Ziira?
suggest.hint: Your old system's records can be moved into Ziira Core: products, customers, suppliers, stock and balances.

overlap.title: Your business is being checked twice
overlap.body: Ziira Core now runs {{areas}}, and {{names}} is still connected. Ziira checks each part only once, so you do not get the same alert twice.
overlap.explain: Pausing stops Ziira reading the old system and deletes nothing. Keeping both keeps the old system's checks too, and each alert says where it came from.
overlap.askedToast: Ziira will tell you again if this happens
overlap.kept: You chose to keep checking {{names}} next to Ziira Core.
